description: This file defines a Java interface called ThingMessageAdapter, which serves as a mixin for thing message adapters in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends a generic Adapter interface with Signal type parameter, and provides default implementations for methods that specify message topic-related groups, channels, criteria, and actions.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set containing the 'THINGS' group for topic paths.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set containing the 'LIVE' channel for topic paths.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set containing the 'MESSAGES' criterion for topic paths.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set for actions, indicating no specific actions are defined.
